title: House Rent Allowance (HRA) Exemption
source: Income Tax Department, Government of India (Income Tax Act 1961 & Income Tax Act 2025)
reference: Section 10(13A) and Rule 2A, Income Tax Act 1961 — recodified under Schedule III, Income Tax Act 2025
content: Salaried individuals who live in rented accommodation can claim House Rent Allowance (HRA) exemption under Section 10(13A) of the Income Tax Act 1961 (recodified under Schedule III of the Income Tax Act 2025). The exempt amount is the MINIMUM of the following three amounts: 1. Actual HRA received from employer. 2. Actual rent paid minus 10% of (Basic Salary + Dearness Allowance). 3. 50% of (Basic Salary + DA) for employees residing in metro cities (Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai) OR 40% of (Basic Salary + DA) for non-metro cities. Rent receipts and landlord's PAN details (if annual rent exceeds ₹1,00,000) are required to claim this exemption. HRA exemption is allowed under the Old Tax Regime and is not available under the New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC / Section 202).
